rules.why: The GPU overview and the chart panels GPU Nodes and GPU Pods open page a fixed number of node and host boxes inside a page that scrolls on purpose, so the footers have no rows-per-page choice.

Cluster View draws every node in the map and pages ten node boxes under it (each at most twelve pod cards), and a node's own view pages its pods sixty at a time; with the map above, either page is taller than the screen, so it scrolls on purpose and the footers have no rows-per-page choice.
